faqs.question: Does this app collect any personal data?
faqs.answer: We do not ask you to create an account or enter your name or email. Preferences and favorites are stored on your device. However, third-party services used in the app (Google AdMob for ads and OneSignal for notifications) may collect device and advertising-related data as described in our Privacy Policy.

faqs.question: How are my data and privacy protected?
faqs.answer: Local settings stay on your device. Ads and notifications are handled by Google AdMob and OneSignal under their own privacy policies. You can limit ad personalization and turn off notifications in your device settings.

faqs.question: Why does the app connect to the internet?
faqs.answer: The app needs internet access to load quotes from public APIs, show ads through Google AdMob, and deliver push notifications through OneSignal (if you allow them). These connections use secure HTTPS where supported.

faqs.question: Does the app use an advertising ID?
faqs.answer: Yes. Google AdMob may use the Android Advertising ID to show and measure ads. You can reset or limit ad tracking in your Android settings.

faqs.question: Does Quotes With Vibe show ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The app shows ads through Google AdMob to keep the app free to use.

faqs.question: Will I receive push notifications?
faqs.answer: Only if you grant notification permission. Notifications are sent using OneSignal. You can disable them anytime in your device or app settings.

faqs.question: Where can I read more about ad and notification privacy?
faqs.answer: Open Settings → Privacy Policy in the app, or visit https://waleed826.github.io/privacy-policy/. You can also review Google’s privacy policy and OneSignal’s privacy policy linked there.

faqs.question: How does the 'Local Storage' feature work?
faqs.answer: Settings and preferences such as theme and language choices are stored locally on your device. These are deleted when you uninstall the app.

faqs.question: Can I share quotes safely?
faqs.answer: Yes. Copy & Share uses your device’s native sharing menu. We do not track who you share with.

faqs.question: Is translation available in the app?
faqs.answer: Yes. Translation may use on-device or third-party translation components. Translated text is processed to show you the result and is not used to create a personal profile in our own systems.

faqs.question: Where do the quotes come from?
faqs.answer: Quotes are sourced from public APIs such as FavQs and Breaking Bad Quotes, along with other community-maintained repositories.

faqs.question: How often are new quotes added?
faqs.answer: Quotes refresh when you visit the app, and you can manually refresh them at any time.

faqs.question: Are quotes fact-checked or moderated?
faqs.answer: Quotes reflect original API content and community submissions. Some quotes may contain strong language. The app is intended for a mature audience.

faqs.question: Is this app intended for children?
faqs.answer: No. Quotes With Vibe is intended for a mature audience and is not directed at children under 13 (or under 16 where required). Please see our Privacy Policy for details.

faqs.question: Why does the privacy policy mention third parties?
faqs.answer: For transparency. AdMob, OneSignal, and quote API providers may process device or technical data (such as advertising ID, push tokens, or IP address) needed to provide their services.

faqs.question: Quotes aren’t loading. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check your internet connection, force-close and reopen the app.

faqs.question: How do I reset preferences?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings → Reset All → Confirm. This clears theme/font selections and your favorites list.

faqs.question: How are updates handled?
faqs.answer: App updates may add features or improvements. If our data practices change in a meaningful way, we will update the Privacy Policy.

faqs.question: Are there ads or paid subscriptions?
faqs.answer: The app is free and supported by ads (Google AdMob). There are currently no required paid subscriptions to browse quotes.

faqs.question: Can I request new quote categories?
faqs.answer: Yes! Email suggestions to information.seeker14@gmail.com

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email information.seeker14@gmail.com with 'Support - Quotes With Vibe' in the subject line.
